description: This file defines an interface IEventFactory and a template class TraceFactoryType for creating message and metadata objects within the Thunder::Messaging namespace. It appears to be part of a messaging framework, providing factory methods for event and metadata message creation with pooling mechanisms.

classes.name: TraceFactoryType
classes.description: A template class implementing IEventFactory, providing pooled creation of metadata and event messages.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Returns a pooled metadata message wrapped in a ProxyType.

methods.name: GetMessage
methods.description: Returns a pooled event message wrapped in a ProxyType.
